articles.summary: DeepSeek 3FS is an open-source distributed file system built specifically for large, read-heavy AI workloads. It delivers strong consistency and fast random reads, but comes with slower writes and significant operational complexity, making it a good fit only for teams running AI at serious scale.
articles.title: When should I be using DeepSeek 3FS for AI?

articles.summary: The industry has discovered that the file system is a surprisingly effective interface to give AI access to data. Here's why file systems are becoming the universal context layer for AI agents.
articles.title: Why file systems are here to stay
